comparisons.peer_topic: Level 3 Fair Value Assets and Liabilities Percentages
comparisons.peer_summary: Total recurring Level 3 assets and liabilities represented small percentages of total consolidated assets and liabilities in both 2024 and 2023, indicating limited reliance on unobservable inputs for the majority of the portfolio.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPM and BAC disclose the percentage of Level 3 fair value assets and liabilities relative to their total balances, indicating the proportion of fair value measurements derived from unobservable inputs. JPM reports Level 3 assets at 2% and liabilities at 9% of total fair value assets and liabilities, respectively. In contrast, BAC reports significantly lower reliance on Level 3 inputs, with recurring Level 3 assets at 0.29% of total consolidated assets and Level 3 liabilities at 0.23% of total consolidated liabilities. While JPM's disclosure includes assets measured on a nonrecurring basis in the percentage calculation, BAC explicitly specifies 'recurring' Level 3 amounts against total consolidated assets/liabilities, showing a substantial difference in the magnitude of unobservable input usage.
